plant_help: Hold the left mouse button and drag a line or area. A single click plants one tree. Cost per tree: {cost} wood, {work} s of work, and {growth} s of growth. Shift adds to the queue and keeps placement active. Up to {limit} tiles per order. Occupied tiles are skipped; only as many trees as available wood allows are paid for. Areas are planted from the center outward.
cancel_help: Cancel queued work for the selected villagers. Unused costs are refunded. Fully grown forests and completed terrain remain.
choose_site: Left mouse button: drag a line or rectangle. Shift adds to the queue. Esc exits. Maximum {limit} tiles.
waterwork_menu: Rivers and water moats. Choose a line width of 1, 3, or 5 tiles, then drag a channel or rectangular area.
waterwork_help: Completed tiles fill with water immediately. Drag direction sets the visible river flow; flow does not speed up ships. Rivers block land units; ships can use a sufficiently wide channel. Water moats also block ships. Width applies to lines; drag to set the size of an area. Cost per tile depth level: {cost} wood and {work} s of work. Creatures and trees move aside; work waits if no free space is available. Buildings are preserved and their tiles are skipped. Restoration returns the original terrain. Shift queues, Esc exits. Up to {limit} tiles.
earthwork_menu: Earthworks: mountains, dry moats, shallow ditches, lakes, and terrain restoration. Open the panel, choose a height, and drag a line or area.
height_help: Choose the height of the next mountain. Slopes form around the selected tile or area. The default mountain is roughly as tall as a tower; repeat the order to raise it further, up to 24 levels.
earthwork_help: Drag a line or area. Cost per level of a selected tile: {cost} wood and {work} s of work; mountain slopes are included. Creatures and trees move to free space. Work waits if no space is available. Dry earthworks replace water with sand. Work can be placed right next to a building; its foundations are preserved. Gentle slopes and shallow ditches are traversable; steep slopes, dry moats, and lakes block land units. Restoration returns the original terrain. The site must be explored. Shift queues, Esc exits. Up to {limit} selected tiles.
treeman_wild_help: A peaceful wild treant. Bring your villager or fighter within {radius} tiles: the treant joins you for free and becomes a combat unit. It cannot be claimed again by approaching. Once tamed, it uses {population} population slots, even above the current limit.
treeman_help: A villager grows a controllable Walking Tree — a slow melee fighter. Cost: {wood} wood and {gold} gold. Work for one villager: {seconds} s. Requires {population} free population slots. Click for one treant; drag for a row. Shift adds the task to the queue. If population space is insufficient, the grown treant waits for a house.
transport_unload_help: Unload passengers. Choose an accessible location on land: the wagon travels there and releases its passengers nearby. If the exit is blocked, clear space and repeat the order.
transport_help: Land transport: {seats} villagers and infantry units. Cost: {wood} wood, {gold} gold; {seconds} s, {population} population slots. Right-click the horse to board; use its unload button and choose a location to disembark. Passengers die if it is destroyed. Archers and spearmen fire a combined volley while stationary. Spears: range 4, no bonus against cavalry. An empty wagon cannot attack.
transport_population_wait: Construction complete. Free population slots required: {population}.
gorynych_wild_help: A peaceful three-headed dragon. Bring your villager or fighter within {radius} tiles: Gorynych joins you permanently. Uses {population} population slots, even above the current limit.
gorynych_help: A flying three-headed dragon. Flies over water, forests, mountains, and buildings; all three heads breathe fire at one target while hovering, also hitting nearby enemies. Ordinary melee attacks cannot reach it. Cost: {wood} wood and {gold} gold; {seconds} s; {population} population slots. Click for one Gorynych, drag for a row, Shift queues.
gorynych_population_wait: Gorynych is ready. Free population slots required: {population}
